note: Six repo_dependency edges from the family's one source repository (repo-ifa-repo-dependency-source) to six distinct target repositories, one per registry relationship type this Odu proves. Every one of the six repo_dependency batched writer templates -- batchCanonicalRepoDependencyUpsertCypher (DEPENDS_ON, canonical.go) plus batchCanonicalDeploysFromRepoRelationshipUpsertCypher, batchCanonicalDiscoversConfigInRepoRelationshipUpsertCypher, batchCanonicalProvisionsDependencyForRepoRelationshipUpsertCypher, batchCanonicalUsesModuleRepoRelationshipUpsertCypher, and batchCanonicalReadsConfigFromRepoRelationshipUpsertCypher (canonical_relationships.go) -- MERGEs on (source_repo:Repository{id})-[:TYPE]->(target_repo:Repository{id}) alone; no property participates in the merge key (materializedEdgeIdentityByFamily["repo_dependency"] declares empty identity for every type), so this 3-tuple is each edge's full structural identity. RUNS_ON, the registry's seventh type, is deliberately absent: see materialized_edges_repo_dependency.go's package doc for why it is not fixture-reachable.
